claims: C1 the user role is defined as input from end users
C2 the user role is also a catch-all for data OpenAI wants to provide to the model

concepts.name: user_role
concepts.gloss: a message role named 'user' whose source is input from end users or a catch-all for data OpenAI wants to provide to the model

concepts.name: openai_provided_data
concepts.gloss: data that OpenAI itself wants to supply to the model, as opposed to input typed by an end user

concepts.name: end_user_input
concepts.gloss: input that comes from an end user of the model

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts

ontology.gloss: R is the user message role, whose source is end-user input or a catch-all for data OpenAI wants to provide to the model
